declared.question: which DF gradient classes (geri3 through (ff|i), gmetric through (i|i)) the low-stack gate must cover, and whether the low-stack form keeps every class within #606's ~14 KB of stack and the 300 s compile budget
declared.rule: per class, over both arches: a class's UNROLLED form is admissible when its stack is at most STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B on sm_86 and on gfx1200 and its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 300 s on both; one not compiled on an arch (above the first L level with an inadmissible class there) is inadmissible. Per target the gate is an L floor, LOWSTACK_MIN_L = the smallest L with an inadmissible class: every class below it must be admissible (so it stays unrolled), every class at or above it is gated. Every low-stack unit must itself be within both budgets on both arches; where one is not, the form is changed, never the budget
declared.expected: the unrolled d1 forms hold the derivative densities per axis (~6x d0's), so geri3's floor is far below d0's L = 10; the low-stack frames are R (n_t(L + 1)), U and the bra tables one index up, about 14 KB at (ff|i)
